title: FAA orders nationwide ground stop of departing flights
summary: The FAA issued a nationwide ground stop on Nov. 13, 2026, halting departing flights, according to the FAA advisory and NYT live-coverage links that constitute the item. The supplied source gives no official cause, scope, or duration; cause details appear only in reader comments citing outside reporting.
